    for role in ("primary", "secondary", "dark", "danger"):
        button = QPushButton(role.title() + " action")
        button.setProperty("role", role)
        controls.append((role, button))
    controls += [("input", QLineEdit("0.001")), ("combo", QComboBox()),
                 ("spin", QSpinBox()), ("check", QCheckBox("Repeat program")), ("row", QToolButton())]
    controls[5][1].addItems(["Independent channels", "Feed"])
    controls[-1][1].setText("Edit case")
    controls[-1][1].setProperty("role", "rowAction")
    for row, (name, control) in enumerate(controls):
        grid.addWidget(QLabel(name.title()), row, 0)
        grid.addWidget(control, row, 1)
        if row:
            QWidget.setTabOrder(controls[row - 1][1], control)
    show_hidden(specimen)
    controls[0][1].setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.TabFocusReason)
    for name, control in controls:
        settle()
        assert control.hasFocus(), f"Keyboard focus did not reach {name}"
        qimage = control.grab().toImage()
        pixels = sum(qimage.pixelColor(x, y).name() == FOCUS
                     for y in range(qimage.height()) for x in range(qimage.width()))
        assert pixels >= 20, f"Missing visible focus on {name}: {pixels} blue pixels"
        evidence["focus"][name] = pixels
        if name in ("primary", "check"):
            capture(specimen, f"focus-{name}")
        QTest.keyClick(control, Qt.Key.Key_Tab)
    specimen.close()

    # Stylesheet padding used to clip the last row even in a two-item popup.
    menu = QComboBox()
    show_hidden(menu)
    for count in (2, 3):
        menu.clear()
        menu.addItems([f"Option {i + 1}" for i in range(count)])
        menu.view().window().setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DontShowOnScreen, True)
        menu.showPopup()
        settle()
        view = menu.view()
        assert view.verticalScrollBar().maximum() == 0
        for row in range(count):
            assert view.viewport().rect().contains(view.visualRect(menu.model().index(row, 0)))
        capture(view.window(), f"dropdown-{count}")
        menu.hidePopup()
    menu.close()
    evidence["checks"].append("Two- and three-item dropdowns show every row without scrolling")

    pairs = {"body/paper": (INK, PAPER, 4.5), "secondary/paper": (MUTED, PAPER, 4.5),
             "body/surface": (INK, SURFACE, 4.5), "primary label": (INK, ACID, 4.5),
             "boundary/surface": (BOUNDARY, SURFACE, 3), "boundary/paper": (BOUNDARY, PAPER, 3),
             "focus/surface": (FOCUS, SURFACE, 3), "focus/primary": (FOCUS, ACID, 3)}
    pairs.update({f"status/{name}": (fg, bg, 4.5) for name, (bg, fg) in STATE_COLORS.items()})
    pairs.update({f"series/{index}": (colour, SURFACE, 3) for index, colour in enumerate(PREVIEW_COLORS)})
    for name, (fg, bg, minimum) in pairs.items():
        ratio = contrast(fg, bg)
        evidence["contrast"][name] = {"ratio": round(ratio, 3), "minimum": minimum}
        assert ratio >= minimum, f"{name}: {ratio:.3f} below {minimum}"
    (out / "audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("All design checks passed. " + str(out / "audit.json"), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Create a reacting case using real Qt mouse/keyboard events at both aspect ratios.

No input documents are filled through the model or imported from examples.

import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

    parser.add_argument("--size", help="Run only WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1280x720")

        return native_exec(dialog)

    def settle(ms=35):
        QTest.qWait(ms)

    def click(widget):
        assert widget.isEnabled() and widget.isVisible(), f"Unavailable: {widget.objectName()} {getattr(widget, 'text', lambda: '')()}"
        point = QPoint(8, widget.height() // 2) if isinstance(widget, QCheckBox) else widget.rect().center()
        assert widget.visibleRegion().contains(point), f"Clipped control: {getattr(widget, 'text', lambda: '')()}"
        QTest.mouseClick(widget, Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton, pos=point)
        settle()

    def button(parent, text):
        return next(b for b in parent.findChildren(QPushButton) if b.text() == text and b.isVisible())

    def type_into(widget, text):
        click(widget)
        QTest.keyClick(widget, Qt.Key.Key_A, Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier)
        QTest.keyClicks(widget, str(text))
        QTest.keyClick(widget, Qt.Key.Key_Tab)
        settle()

    def dialog_action(opener, action):
        errors = []
        def handle():
            dialog = app.activeModalWidget()
            try:
                assert dialog is not None
                action(dialog)
            except BaseException as exc:
                errors.append(exc)
                if dialog:
                    dialog.reject()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, handle)
        click(opener)
        if errors:
            raise errors[0]

    def pick_items(opener, keys):
        def select(dialog):
            items = dialog.findChild(QListWidget)
            for key in keys:
                row = next(i for i in range(items.count()) if items.item(i).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) == key)
                click(items)
                QTest.keyClick(items, Qt.Key.Key_Home)
                for _ in range(row):
                    QTest.keyClick(items, Qt.Key.Key_Down)
                assert items.currentRow() == row
                if items.currentItem().checkState() != Qt.CheckState.Checked:
                    QTest.keyClick(items, Qt.Key.Key_Space)

        dialog_action(opener, select)

        QTest.keyClick(table, Qt.Key.Key_F2)

            choose(editor.bed.basis, "Solid volume")

"""Build one portable HTML handoff from DESIGN.md, screenshots and source snapshots.

Uses only the standard library. The small Markdown renderer covers the deliberate
subset used by this document: headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, links, images,
inline code/bold and fenced code. The generated file needs no scripts or network.
"""
from base64 import b64encode
from hashlib import sha256
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import unicodedata

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DESKTOP = ROOT / "desktop"
DOCUMENT = DESKTOP / "DESIGN.md"
OUTPUT = DESKTOP / "MultiSolid-design-guide.html"
MODULES = (
    "theme", "identity", "welcome_animation", "window", "editor_widgets", "editor",
    "bed", "program_editor", "chemistry", "general", "case_list", "reaction_graph",
    "study_editor", "results", "report",
)
SOURCES = [DESKTOP / "packed_bed_ui" / f"{name}.py" for name in MODULES]
SOURCES += sorted((DESKTOP / "packed_bed_ui/assets").glob("*.svg"))
SOURCES += [DESKTOP / "pyproject.toml"]
SOURCES += [DESKTOP / "tools" / name for name in (
    "design_review.py", "authoring_review.py", "build_design_guide.py",
)]
SOURCES += [DESKTOP / "tests" / name for name in (
    "test_identity.py", "test_editor.py", "test_window.py",
)]
SOURCES += [DESKTOP / "design" / name for name in (
    "audit.json", "audit-scale-2.json", "authoring-audit.json",
    "authoring-audit-scale-2.json", "verification.md",
)]
# Preserve the previously used standalone native animation capture recipe too.
if (ROOT / "build/render-front.py").exists():
    SOURCES += [ROOT / "build/render-front.py"]


def slug(text):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-")


def data_uri(path, mime):
    return f"data:{mime};base64," + b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode()


def main():
    source_ids = {path.resolve(): "source-" + slug(str(path.relative_to(ROOT))) for path in SOURCES}
    images = {}
    headings = []
    used_ids = set()

    def image_ref(target, title):
        path = (DOCUMENT.parent / target).resolve()
        assert path.is_file(), f"Missing illustration: {path}"
        if path not in images:
            images[path] = {"id": "figure-" + slug(path.stem), "title": title, "shown": False}
        return path, images[path]

    def link(target):
        if target.startswith(("https://", "http://", "#")):
            return target
        path = (DOCUMENT.parent / target).resolve()
        if path in source_ids:
            return "#" + source_ids[path]
        if path.suffix.lower() in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg"):
            _, item = image_ref(target, path.stem)
            return "#" + item["id"]
        raise ValueError(f"Unembedded local link: {target}")

    pattern = re.compile(r"`([^`]+)`|\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)|\*\*([^*]+)\*\*")

    def inline(text):
        result, end = [], 0
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            result.append(escape(text[end:match.start()]))
            code, label, target, bold = match.groups()
            if code is not None:
                result.append("<code>" + escape(code) + "</code>")
            elif label is not None:
                result.append(f'<a href="{escape(link(target), quote=True)}">{inline(label)}</a>')
            else:
                result.append("<strong>" + escape(bold) + "</strong>")
            end = match.end()
        result.append(escape(text[end:]))
        return "".join(result)

    def figure(path, item):
        item["shown"] = True
        mime = "image/png" if path.suffix == ".png" else "image/jpeg"
        dimensions = ""
        if path.suffix == ".png":
            width, height = struct.unpack(">II", path.read_bytes()[16:24])
            dimensions = f'width="{width}" height="{height}" '
        return (f'<figure id="{item["id"]}"><img loading="lazy" {dimensions}src="{data_uri(path, mime)}" '
                f'alt="{escape(item["title"], quote=True)}"><figcaption>{escape(item["title"])}</figcaption></figure>')

    lines = DOCUMENT.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    blocks, i = [], 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if not line.strip():
            i += 1
            continue
        if line.startswith("```"):
            language, code = line[3:], []
            i += 1
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith("```"):
                code.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            assert i < len(lines), "Unclosed code fence"
            blocks.append(f'<pre class="recipe" data-language="{escape(language)}"><code>'
                          + escape("\n".join(code)) + "</code></pre>")
            i += 1
            continue
        heading = re.match(r"^(#{1,6}) (.+)$", line)
        if heading:
            level, title = len(heading[1]), heading[2]
            identifier = slug(title)
            assert identifier not in used_ids, identifier
            used_ids.add(identifier)
            headings.append((level, title, identifier))
            blocks.append(f'<h{level} id="{identifier}">{inline(title)}</h{level}>')
            i += 1
            continue
        picture = re.fullmatch(r"!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)", line.strip())
        if picture:
            path, item = image_ref(picture[2], picture[1])
            blocks.append(figure(path, item))
            i += 1
            continue
        if line.startswith("|"):
            rows = []
            while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("|"):
                rows.append([cell.strip() for cell in lines[i].strip().strip("|").split("|")])
                i += 1
            assert len(rows) > 1 and all(re.fullmatch(r":?-+:?", c) for c in rows[1])
            assert all(len(row) == len(rows[0]) for row in rows), "Uneven Markdown table"
            table = "<div class=table-wrap><table><thead><tr>" + "".join(
                "<th>" + inline(c) + "</th>" for c in rows[0]) + "</tr></thead><tbody>"
            table += "".join("<tr>" + "".join("<td>" + inline(c) + "</td>" for c in row)
                             + "</tr>" for row in rows[2:])
            blocks.append(table + "</tbody></table></div>")
            continue
        marker = re.match(r"^(\d+\. |[-*] )(.+)$", line)
        if marker:
            tag = "ol" if marker[1][0].isdigit() else "ul"
            items = []
            while i < len(lines):
                match = re.match(r"^(\d+\. |[-*] )(.+)$", lines[i])
                if not match:
                    break
                assert ("ol" if match[1][0].isdigit() else "ul") == tag
                text = [match[2]]
                i += 1
                while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("   "):
                    text.append(lines[i].strip())
                    i += 1
                items.append("<li>" + inline(" ".join(text)) + "</li>")
            blocks.append(f"<{tag}>" + "".join(items) + f"</{tag}>")
            continue
        paragraph = [line.strip()]
        i += 1
        while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip() and not re.match(r"^(#|```|\||!\[|\d+\. |[-*] )", lines[i]):
            paragraph.append(lines[i].strip())
            i += 1
        blocks.append("<p>" + inline(" ".join(paragraph)) + "</p>")

    blocks.append('<h2 id="supporting-captures">Supporting captures</h2>')
    for path, item in images.items():
        if not item["shown"]:
            blocks.append(figure(path, item))
    blocks.append('<h2 id="source-snapshots">Source snapshots and audit evidence</h2>')
    blocks.append('<p>These are the files captured when this guide was built. Expand a file to read '
                  'or copy it; its download link restores the exact bytes. Hashes identify this '
                  'working-tree snapshot. The code belongs to the existing MultiSolid application '
                  'and requires its remaining modules. The audit records are historical evidence.</p>')
    for path in SOURCES:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        label = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        digest = sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        blocks.append(f'<details id="{source_ids[path.resolve()]}" class="source"><summary>'
                      f'{escape(label)} <span>{len(raw):,} bytes</span></summary>'
                      f'<p><a download="{escape(path.name)}" href="{data_uri(path, "text/plain;charset=utf-8")}">'
                      f'Download {escape(path.name)}</a></p><p class="hash">SHA-256 {digest}</p>'
                      '<pre><code>' + escape(raw.decode("utf-8")) + '</code></pre></details>')
    toc = [f'<li><a href="#{identifier}">{escape(title)}</a></li>'
           for level, title, identifier in headings if level == 2]
    toc += ['<li><a href="#supporting-captures">Supporting captures</a></li>',
            '<li><a href="#source-snapshots">Source snapshots &amp; evidence</a></li>']
    css = """
    :root{--paper:#f1f0e8;--surface:#faf9f3;--ink:#242720;--muted:#65685c;--line:#d0d1c4;--lime:#d9f36d;--link:#245b83}
    *{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-padding-top:24px}
    body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.65 'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif}
    header{background:var(--ink);color:var(--surface);padding:24px 32px;border-bottom:5px solid var(--lime)}
    header strong{font-family:Impact,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:.04em}
    header span{margin-left:20px;color:#d2d6c8}nav{position:sticky;top:24px;align-self:start;padding:20px 22px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);max-height:calc(100vh - 48px);overflow:auto}
    nav b{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em}nav ul{list-style:none;margin:12px 0 0;padding:0}nav li{margin:8px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}
    .layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:245px minmax(0,1000px);gap:38px;max-width:1380px;padding:36px 28px;margin:auto}
    main{min-width:0}h1{font-size:40px;line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.03em;max-width:850px;margin:0 0 16px}
    h2{font-size:27px;line-height:1.25;margin:56px 0 20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
    h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;margin:32px 0 12px}p{margin:14px 0}a{color:var(--link);text-underline-offset:3px}
    a:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--link);outline-offset:4px}li{margin:10px 0}
    code{font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Mono',monospace;font-size:.9em;background:#e5e7dc;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
    pre{background:#e8eadf;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 20px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;overflow:auto;tab-size:4}
    pre code{background:transparent;padding:0;white-space:pre;overflow-wrap:normal}
    .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:22px 0}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;background:var(--surface);font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
    th,td{padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);text-align:left;vertical-align:top}th{background:#e5e7dc;font-weight:600}td:first-child{min-width:145px}tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#f4f4ed}
    figure{margin:26px 0;padding:0}figure img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--line)}figcaption{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);padding-top:8px}
    details{margin:12px 0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 18px}summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}summary span{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);margin-left:12px}.hash{font:11px/1.5 Consolas,monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere}details pre{max-height:650px}
    footer{margin-top:36px;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
    @media(max-width:1000px){.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:900px;padding:24px}nav{position:static;max-height:none}nav ul{columns:2}h1{font-size:34px}}
    @media(max-width:580px){header{padding:16px}header span{display:block;margin:5px 0 0}.layout{padding:18px;gap:24px}nav ul{columns:1}h1{font-size:30px}h2{font-size:24px}th,td{padding:8px;font-size:13px}pre{padding:12px}}
    @media print{body{background:white;font-size:10pt}header{background:white;color:black;border-bottom:2pt solid black;padding:0 0 12pt}header span{color:black}.layout{display:block;padding:18pt 0;max-width:none}nav{display:none}h1{font-size:26pt}h2{font-size:18pt;margin-top:24pt}h3{font-size:13pt}pre,table{font-size:8pt}.table-wrap{overflow:visible}tr,figure{break-inside:avoid}a{color:inherit}details pre{max-height:none;white-space:pre-wrap}pre code{white-space:pre-wrap}img{max-height:640px;object-fit:contain}h2,h3{break-after:avoid}}
    """
    html = ('<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">'
            '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">'
            '<meta name="description" content="MultiSolid visual design decisions, sources and reconstruction specification">'
            '<title>MultiSolid — graphical design &amp; reconstruction guide</title><style>' + css
            + '</style></head><body><header><strong>MULTISOLID</strong><span>Design decisions / reconstruction guide</span></header>'
            '<div class="layout"><nav aria-label="Guide contents"><b>CONTENTS</b><ul>'
            + ''.join(toc) + '</ul></nav><main>' + '\n'.join(blocks)
            + '<footer>Self-contained edition. Screenshots, source snapshots and audit evidence are embedded. '
            'External links identify the primary references.</footer></main></div></body></html>')
    OUTPUT.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT}: {len(html.encode('utf-8')):,} bytes, {len(SOURCES)} source/evidence files, {len(images)} illustrations")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Welcome motion remains optional and does no timer work away from the page."""

from PyQt6.QtCore import QSettings
from PyQt6.QtTest import QTest

from packed_bed_ui.welcome_animation import CycleEmblem, PARTICLES, PARTICLE_COLUMNS


def test_animation_pause_persists_and_hidden_time_is_excluded(qt_app, tmp_path):
    settings = QSettings(str(tmp_path / "motion.ini"), QSettings.Format.IniFormat)
    art = CycleEmblem(settings=settings)
    assert not art.timer.isActive()
    art.show()
    QTest.qWait(100)
    assert art.timer.isActive() and art.seconds > 0
    art.pause_button.click()
    assert art.paused and not art.timer.isActive()
    seconds = art.seconds
    QTest.qWait(100)
    assert art.seconds == seconds
    reopened = CycleEmblem(settings=settings)
    reopened.show()
    assert reopened.paused and not reopened.timer.isActive()
    reopened.pause_button.click()
    QTest.qWait(100)
    assert reopened.timer.isActive() and reopened.seconds > 0
    reopened.hide()
    seconds = reopened.seconds
    QTest.qWait(100)
    assert not reopened.timer.isActive() and reopened.seconds == seconds
    reopened.show()
    assert reopened.timer.isActive()
    art.close()
    reopened.close()


def test_particle_front_moves_upward_without_flicker_or_cycle_reset():
    half_cycle = CycleEmblem.PERIOD_SECONDS / 2
    previous = CycleEmblem.particle_states(0, 0)
    assert not any(previous)
    for step in range(1, 101):
        current = CycleEmblem.particle_states(0, half_cycle * step / 100)
        assert all(not old or new for old, new in zip(previous, current))
        previous = current
    assert all(previous)
    for step in range(1, 101):
        current = CycleEmblem.particle_states(0, half_cycle * (1 + step / 100))
        assert all(old or not new for old, new in zip(previous, current))
        previous = current
    assert not any(previous)

    halfway = CycleEmblem.particle_states(0, half_cycle / 2)
    assert all(state for (_, y), state in zip(PARTICLES, halfway) if y > 45)
    assert not any(state for (_, y), state in zip(PARTICLES, halfway) if y < -45)
    # The transition scatters among individual grains, not complete rows.
    assert any(0 < sum(halfway[row:row + PARTICLE_COLUMNS]) < PARTICLE_COLUMNS
               for row in range(0, len(PARTICLES), PARTICLE_COLUMNS))
    CycleEmblem.particle_states(0, half_cycle * 2.3)
    assert CycleEmblem.particle_states(0, half_cycle / 2) == halfway

@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode, key", [("separate_channels", "inlet_composition"), ("feed_stream", "feed_stream")])

@pytest.mark.parametrize("row", [0, 1], ids=["initial", "ramp"])

@pytest.mark.parametrize("normalize", [False, True], ids=["entered", "normalized"])

def test_composition_precision_survives_save_and_reopen(editing, monkeypatch, mode, key, row, normalize):

    from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QLabel, QLineEdit, QPushButton



    editor, case = editing

    initial = {"N2": 1.0, "H2": 0.0, "O2": 0.0}

    editor.set_species("gas", list(initial))

    editor.program.mode.setCurrentIndex(editor.program.mode.findData(mode))

    channel = editor.program.channels[key]

    state = ({"flow": 1.234567891234567e-8, "temperature": 300.1234567891234, "composition": initial}

             if key == "feed_stream" else initial)

    channel.write({"initial": deepcopy(state), "steps": [

        {"kind": "ramp", "duration_s": 1.0, "target": deepcopy(state)},

    ]})

    expected = ({name: 1 / 3 for name in initial} if normalize else

                {"N2": 0.987654321, "H2": 0.011111111, "O2": 0.001234568})



    def enter_composition(dialog):

        for name, value in expected.items():

            dialog.findChild(QLineEdit, name).setText("1" if normalize else str(value))

        if normalize:

            next(button for button in dialog.findChildren(QPushButton) if button.text() == "Normalize").click()

        return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted



    monkeypatch.setattr(QDialog, "exec", enter_composition)

    channel.edit_state(row)

    assert editor.save()



    def accept_unchanged(dialog):

        assert {name: float(dialog.findChild(QLineEdit, name).text()) for name in expected} == expected

        assert any(label.text() == "Total: 1" for label in dialog.findChildren(QLabel))

        return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted



    monkeypatch.setattr(QDialog, "exec", accept_unchanged)

    for _ in range(2):

        reopened = Project.open(case.project.root).cases[0]

        saved = reopened.documents["program"][key]

        value = saved["initial"] if row == 0 else saved["steps"][0]["target"]

        assert (value["composition"] if key == "feed_stream" else value) == expected

        if key == "feed_stream":

            assert value["flow"] == state["flow"]

            assert value["temperature"] == state["temperature"]

        reopened.resolve()  # The engine's 1e-12 sum constraint must still pass.

        assert editor.set_case(reopened)

        editor.program.channels[key].edit_state(row)

        assert editor.save()

from time import monotonic, sleep

import sys



import pytest



from packed_bed_ui.project import Project, input_hashes, read_json, write_json

from packed_bed_ui.worker import activate_snapshot





def wait_until(app, condition, timeout=10):

    deadline = monotonic() + timeout

    while not condition():

        assert monotonic() < deadline, "Timed out waiting for the Qt worker"

        app.processEvents()

        sleep(0.01)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["cancel", "crash", "failed_start"])

def test_controller_stops_workers_and_retains_results_of_unstarted_cases(qt_app, tmp_path, source_case, monkeypatch, action):

    from packed_bed_ui.execution import RunController



    project = Project.create(tmp_path / "project")

    first = project.add_case_from_files(source_case)

    second = project.duplicate_case(first, "Second")

    # The second case already has results. A queued cancellation must keep them.

    job = read_json(project.prepare_execution([second]))

    activate_snapshot(second.root / f".pending-{job['attempt_id']}")

    write_json(second.run_folder / "status.json", {"state": "completed"})

    (second.run_folder / "result.txt").write_text("keep")

    hashes = input_hashes(second.run_folder / "inputs")

    path = project.prepare_execution(project.cases)

    controller = RunController()

    start = controller.process.start

    if action == "failed_start":

        monkeypatch.setattr(controller.process, "start", lambda *_: start(str(tmp_path / "missing-python"), []))

    else:

        script = '''

import time, sys

from pathlib import Path

from packed_bed_ui.project import read_json, write_json

from packed_bed_ui.worker import activate_snapshot

path = Path(sys.argv[1])

job = read_json(path)

case_id = next(iter(job['cases']))

folder = activate_snapshot(path.parent / 'cases' / case_id / ('.pending-' + job['attempt_id']))

write_json(folder / 'status.json', {'state': 'running'})

job['cases'][case_id]['state'] = 'running'

write_json(path, job)

print('ready', flush=True)

while not (path.parent / (".cancel-" + job["attempt_id"])).exists():

    time.sleep(0.02)

''' if action == "cancel" else "raise SystemExit(7)"

        monkeypatch.setattr(controller.process, "start", lambda *_: start(sys.executable, ["-c", script, str(path)]))

    controller.start(path)

    if action == "cancel":

        log = project.root / "execution.log"

        wait_until(qt_app, lambda: log.exists() and "ready" in log.read_text())

        controller.cancel()

    wait_until(qt_app, lambda: not controller.active)

    assert read_json(path)["state"] == ("cancelled" if action == "cancel" else "failed")

    assert (second.run_folder / "result.txt").read_text() == "keep"

    assert second.state()["state"] == "completed"

    assert input_hashes(second.run_folder / "inputs") == hashes

    if action == "cancel":

        assert first.state()["state"] == "cancelled"

    assert not list(project.root.glob("cases/*/.pending-*"))

    case.documents["run"]["simulation"]["repeat_program"] = True

    other = Project.create(tmp_path / "other")

    window = MainWindow()

    window._set_project(project)

    window._show_case(case)

    window.show()

    window.editor.fields[("simulation", "time_horizon_s")].setText("0.02")

    window.editor.queue_edit()



    def fail():

        raise PermissionError("test destination is read-only")



    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:

        patch.setattr(case, "save", fail)

        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Save the current draft"):

            window._set_project(other)

        assert window.project is project

        assert not window.close()

        assert window.editor.dirty

    assert window.close()

    assert Project.open(project.root).cases[0].documents["run"]["simulation"]["time_horizon_s"] == 0.02

@pytest.mark.parametrize("target", ["case", "study", "study_case"])

def test_inclusion_mouse_and_keyboard_controls_persist_and_select_run_all(qt_app, tmp_path, source_case, monkeypatch, target):

    from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt

    from PyQt6.QtTest import QTest

    from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QStyle, QStyleOptionViewItem

    from packed_bed_ui.window import MainWindow



    project = Project.create(tmp_path / "project")

    independent = project.add_case_from_files(source_case, "Independent")

    children = [project.duplicate_case(independent, f"Variant {i}") for i in range(2)]

    project.metadata["studies"].append({"id": "study", "name": "Study"})

    for child in children:

        child.metadata["study_id"] = "study"

    window = MainWindow()

    window._set_project(project)

    window.show()

    qt_app.processEvents()

    tree = window.table

    item, excluded = {

        "case": (tree.items[independent.id], [independent]),

        "study": (tree.groups["study"], children),

        "study_case": (tree.items[children[0].id], [children[0]]),

    }[target]



    def click_checkbox():

        option = QStyleOptionViewItem()

        option.initFrom(tree)

        option.rect = tree.visualRect(tree.indexFromItem(item, 0))

        option.features = QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.HasCheckIndicator

        option.checkState = item.checkState(0)

        check = tree.style().subElementRect(QStyle.SubElement.SE_ItemViewItemCheckIndicator, option, tree)

        assert check.isValid()

        QTest.mouseClick(tree.viewport(), Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton, pos=check.center())



    try:

        click_checkbox()

        assert all(not case.metadata["included"] for case in excluded)

        assert window.run_all_button.text() == f"Run all included cases ({3 - len(excluded)})"

        tree.setCurrentItem(item, 0)

        QTest.keyClick(tree, Qt.Key.Key_Space)

        assert all(case.metadata["included"] for case in project.cases)

        click_checkbox()

        included = [case.id for case in project.cases if case not in excluded]

        assert [case.id for case in Project.open(project.root).cases if case.metadata["included"]] == included

        assert window.pages.currentWidget() is window.home



        window.runner.active = True

        window._set_running(True)

        click_checkbox()

        QTest.keyClick(tree, Qt.Key.Key_Space)

        assert all(not case.metadata["included"] for case in excluded)

        window.runner.active = False

        window._set_running(False)



        jobs = []

        monkeypatch.setattr(window.runner, "start", lambda path: jobs.append(read_json(path)))

        window._run_all()

        assert list(jobs[0]["cases"]) == included

    finally:

        window.runner.active = False

        window.close()

def test_study_groups_keep_selection_and_collapse_during_live_updates(qt_app, tmp_path, source_case):

    from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt

    from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QPushButton

    from packed_bed_ui.window import MainWindow



    project = Project.create(tmp_path / "project")

    first = project.add_case_from_files(source_case, "Benchmark")

    children = [project.duplicate_case(first, f"Variant {i}") for i in range(3)]

    project.metadata["studies"].append({"id": "study", "name": "Program × solids"})

    for child in children:

        child.metadata["study_id"] = "study"

    window = MainWindow()

    window._set_project(project)

    assert window.menuBar().actions()[0].text() == "Project"

    assert window.table.topLevelItemCount() == 2

    assert [window.table.headerItem().text(i) for i in range(5)] == ["Include", "Case", "Inputs", "Latest result", "Actions"]

    group = window.table.groups["study"]

    assert group.childCount() == 3

    group.setExpanded(False)

    window.table.setCurrentItem(window.table.items[first.id])

    group.setCheckState(0, Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)

    assert all(not child.metadata["included"] for child in children)

    assert first.metadata["included"]

    group.child(0).setCheckState(0, Qt.CheckState.Checked)

    assert group.checkState(0) == Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked

    window.runner.active = True

    window.runner.job = {"cases": {children[0].id: {"state": "running", "elapsed_s": 2.0}}}

    window._run_status(window.runner.job)

    assert not group.isExpanded()

    assert window.table.currentItem() is window.table.items[first.id]

    assert "1 running" in group.text(3)

    assert window.table.items[children[0].id].text(3) == "Running (2.0 s)"

    window.runner.active = False

    window._set_running(False)

    assert list(window.table.buttons[first.id]) == ["Run", "Duplicate", "Edit", "Delete"]

    assert all(not button.icon().isNull() for button in window.table.buttons[first.id].values())

    buttons = {button.text(): button for button in window.home.findChildren(QPushButton)}

    assert buttons["New Parameter Study"].isEnabled()

    assert buttons["Import Parameter Study"].isEnabled()

    window.max_workers.setValue(3)

    assert Project.open(project.root).metadata["max_workers"] == 3

    window.close()





def test_elapsed_time_advances_without_solver_status_updates(qt_app, tmp_path, monkeypatch):

    from packed_bed_ui.execution import RunController

    import packed_bed_ui.execution as execution



    controller = RunController()

    controller.path = tmp_path / "execution.json"

    controller.active = True

    controller.started = 10.0

    write_json(controller.path, {"cases": {

        "active": {"state": "running", "started_at": 11.0, "elapsed_s": 0.2},

        "finished": {"state": "completed", "started_at": 11.0, "elapsed_s": 0.5},

        "queued": {"state": "queued", "elapsed_s": 0.0},

    }})

    for now in (12.0, 15.0):

        monkeypatch.setattr(execution, "perf_counter", lambda: now)

        cases = controller._read_status()["cases"]

        assert cases["active"]["elapsed_s"] == now - 11.0

        assert cases["finished"]["elapsed_s"] == 0.5

        assert cases["queued"]["elapsed_s"] == 0.0

    controller.active = False





def test_cancel_reaps_parallel_workers_and_keeps_queued_results(qt_app, tmp_path, source_case, monkeypatch):

    import os

    from pathlib import Path

    from packed_bed_ui.execution import RunController



    project = Project.create(tmp_path / "project")

    first = project.add_case_from_files(source_case)

    second = project.duplicate_case(first, "Second")

    queued = project.duplicate_case(first, "Queued")

    previous = read_json(project.prepare_execution([queued]))

    activate_snapshot(queued.root / f".pending-{previous['attempt_id']}")

    write_json(queued.run_folder / "status.json", {"state": "completed"})

    (queued.run_folder / "result.txt").write_text("keep")

    path = project.prepare_execution(project.cases, max_workers=2)

    script = tmp_path / "slow_job.py"

    script.write_text(

        "import sys\n"

        f"sys.path.insert(0, {str(Path(__file__).parent)!r})\n"

        "from test_worker import slow_prepared_case\n"

        "from packed_bed_ui.worker import run_project_job\n"

        "if __name__ == '__main__':\n"

        "    raise SystemExit(run_project_job(sys.argv[1], case_worker=slow_prepared_case))\n"

    )

    controller = RunController()

    start = controller.process.start

    monkeypatch.setattr(controller.process, "start", lambda *_: start(sys.executable, [str(script), str(path)]))

    controller.start(path)

    wait_until(qt_app, lambda: all((case.run_folder / "pid.json").exists() for case in (first, second)))

    pids = [read_json(case.run_folder / "pid.json")["pid"] for case in (first, second)]

    controller.cancel()

    wait_until(qt_app, lambda: not controller.active)

    assert read_json(path)["state"] == "cancelled"

    assert [case.state()["state"] for case in project.cases] == ["cancelled", "cancelled", "completed"]

    assert (queued.run_folder / "result.txt").read_text() == "keep"

    assert not list(project.root.glob("cases/*/.pending-*"))

    if os.name == "posix":

        for pid in pids:

            with pytest.raises(ProcessLookupError):

                os.kill(pid, 0)

SHA-256 2eccfa1dd43f898ad63758be7aa55e295d61a5d67dd90bd2e1efef7c67d9cfe0

# Authoring revision verification

26 September 2026 · Windows · native Qt rendering for visual audits.

The final functional run passed **108 tests**, with **one skip** for a POSIX-only
Graphviz helper. Two DAETools dependency deprecation warnings were emitted.

```powershell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest desktop/tests/test_editor.py desktop/tests/test_window.py desktop/tests/test_identity.py desktop/tests/test_preview.py desktop/tests/test_graph_view.py desktop/tests/test_report.py desktop/tests/test_study_editor.py desktop/tests/test_project_results.py -q
```

An earlier run hit the 10-second worker-start deadline in
`test_cancel_reaps_parallel_workers_and_keeps_queued_results` while native captures
were also executing. That test passed in isolation, then passed in the final
108-test run. No worker code or timeout was changed for this revision.

The authoring review passed at 1024 × 768, 1280 × 960, 1280 × 720 and 1920 × 1080.
It also passed at 1024 × 768 logical pixels with `QT_SCALE_FACTOR=2`. Each run
created its own empty project, entered a reacting case through native controls,
opened numerical previews, and returned to an enabled Run action. Exact saved
inputs were checked after a program-mode round trip. The temporary projects are
removed by the review; the JSON audits and screenshots remain.

Both presentation audits passed, at 100% and 200% scaling: preview geometry,
scientific array equality, colour/stroke distinctions, keyboard focus, short-menu
geometry, input validation and save-error recovery. Captures include all four
aspect-ratio/size combinations. These audits use an imported example and are
complementary to the empty-project authoring check.

The authoring review does not execute the new reacting case. “Inputs ready” means
the entered inputs pass structural validation, not that a reaction simulation has
completed or that its scientific assumptions have been independently validated.

Retained evidence:

- [Authoring audit](authoring-audit.json) and [200% authoring audit](authoring-audit-scale-2.json)
- [Presentation audit](audit.json) and [200% presentation audit](audit-scale-2.json)
- [Small 4:3 Bed setup](bed-1024.png)
- [Small 16:9 Program setup](program-1280x720.png)
- [Small 16:9 Chemistry setup](chemistry-1280x720.png)
- [Full-page Program preview](program-preview-1024.png)

Full generated captures are under `build/usability/current`,
`build/usability/scale-2`, `build/design-review/current` and
`build/design-review/scale-2`. The updated design document describes the previous
review's shortcomings and the remaining limits of automated workflow testing.

## Packed-circle animation refinement

The subsequent animation revision restores circles and helical envelopes. Three
focused tests passed: persistent pause/hidden-time behaviour, upward front
progression without flicker or a whole-bed reset between sweeps, and welcome
navigation. The front test also checks scattered states within individual rows.
Native rendering checks confirmed live frame changes, paused frame stability,
resume, and fit at all four window sizes above.

Each grain has a fixed switching threshold for a given sweep. A new sweep uses a
fresh seeded pattern, keeping motion reproducible and independent of repaint
frequency. Circles have two discrete colours; continuous blending belongs to the
helices. A front takes 24 seconds, alternating states across a 48-second cycle.
Helices rotate over 36 seconds and blend their colours over 60 seconds.

The animation captures and a 24-second GIF excerpt are in `build/animation-review`.
The GIF loops the excerpt; the live animation continues with subsequent fronts.

SHA-256 69bc315c2e08a3ba26bed5d169265e2a6dc56863a816d6c94c96e593e2df6eb7

"""Capture the native welcome and a real-time excerpt of its artwork."""

import json

import os

from pathlib import Path

import sys

from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from time import perf_counter



ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'desktop'))

os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'windows'

from PIL import Image

from PyQt6.QtCore import QSettings, Qt

from PyQt6.QtTest import QTest

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from packed_bed_ui.window import MainWindow

from packed_bed_ui.welcome_animation import CycleEmblem



app = QApplication([])

out = ROOT / 'build/animation-review'

out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

with TemporaryDirectory(dir=out) as temporary:

    window = MainWindow(settings=QSettings(str(Path(temporary) / 'settings.ini'), QSettings.Format.IniFormat))

    window.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DontShowOnScreen, True)

    window.show()

    app.setActiveWindow(window)

    art = window.findChild(CycleEmblem)

    QTest.qWait(80)

    before = art.grab().toImage()

    QTest.qWait(500)

    assert art.grab().toImage() != before

    art.pause_button.click()

    paused = art.grab().toImage()

    QTest.qWait(150)

    assert art.grab().toImage() == paused

    art.pause_button.click()

    assert art.timer.isActive()

    art._stop()

    evidence = {'sizes': [], 'seconds_per_front': art.PERIOD_SECONDS / 2, 'motion': 'advance, pause and resume passed'}

    for width, height in ((1024, 768), (1280, 960), (1280, 720), (1920, 1080)):

        window.resize(width, height)

        art._seconds = 8

        app.processEvents()

        assert (window.width(), window.height()) == (width, height)

        assert art.pause_button.visibleRegion().contains(art.pause_button.rect().center())

        assert window.grab().save(str(out / f'welcome-{width}x{height}.png'))

        evidence['sizes'].append([width, height])

    window.resize(1280, 720)

    app.processEvents()

    for seconds in (0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48):

        art._seconds = seconds

        art.grab().save(str(out / f'frame-{seconds:02}.png'))

    frames = []

    started = perf_counter()

    for frame in range(240):

        art._seconds = frame / 10

        qimage = art.grab().toImage()

        qimage = qimage.convertToFormat(qimage.Format.Format_RGBA8888)

        pixels = qimage.bits()

        pixels.setsize(qimage.sizeInBytes())

        frame_image = Image.frombytes('RGBA', (qimage.width(), qimage.height()), bytes(pixels))

        frames.append(frame_image.convert('RGB').quantize(colors=128))

    evidence['render_ms_per_frame'] = round((perf_counter() - started) * 1000 / len(frames), 2)

    frames[0].save(out / 'packed-bed-motion.gif', save_all=True, append_images=frames[1:], duration=100, loop=0)

    window.close()

    assert not art.timer.isActive()

    (out / 'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2))

    print(json.dumps(evidence), flush=True)
Self-contained edition. Screenshots, source snapshots and audit evidence are embedded. External links identify the primary references.
